listings.model: Ibanez RG Backplate & Tremolo Cavity Cover for RG and JEM Models — Multiple Colors
listings.title: Ibanez Backplate Tremolo Cover for JEM & RG Models - Gold
listings.description:
Upgrade your Ibanez RG or JEM with this precision-crafted replacement tremolo cavity cover. Made in small batches right here at Ploutone with a durable textured finish that matches OEM quality, this drop-in replacement is perfect when your original cover is cracked, missing, or just due for a refresh. Available in multiple colors to suit your guitar, it delivers a clean look while keeping your tremolo cavity protected.

Need a specific color? Contact us for custom orders!

What's Included:
  • 1x Tremolo cavity cover
Specifications:
  • Material: Advanced bio-plastics - durable and renewable
  • Finish: Textured matte surface
  • Compatibility: Most Japanese-made Ibanez RG and JEM models
  • Mounting: Uses existing screw holes (screws not included)
Fitment Guide:

This tremolo cavity cover is designed to fit most Japanese-made (MIJ) Ibanez RG and JEM series guitars. It may also fit some Indonesian-made (MII) models, though we recommend checking your existing cover dimensions before ordering. To verify fitment, measure your current cover and compare to the dimensions in the photos. If your measurements match and your screw hole spacing lines up, this cover should fit perfectly. Not sure about compatibility? Send us a message and we'll do our best to help!

About Our In-House Made Gear

These covers are part of our exclusive line of handmade guitar parts — crafted by us, for you. We're dedicated to creating unique solutions you won't find anywhere else, from affordable hard-to-find replacements to premium artisan accessories. Every piece balances innovation, quality, and value.

Need a specific color or a custom order? Contact us and we'll make it happen.
